# United Kingdom death registration (England and Wales)

> Registering a death in England and Wales after a doctor has completed the medical certificate of cause of death (MCCD): the 5-day deadline, the qualified informant, medical examiner confirmation, coroner involvement, the certificate for burial or cremation, Tell Us Once, and ordering certified copies of the death certificate. A single continuous single-page wizard checks whether the death is **ready to register** and raises flagged issues.
